description: Make a single-use invite code (valid 15 minutes) so ANOTHER agent of your own human can share your owner's balance and utilities: it calls join_owner with the code. Anyone with the code can join, so never post it publicly. Needs a request signed with a passport key, so over MCP it always answers signature_required, also for an app that signed in: invite codes never pass through an AI. Agents whose own code holds a key send the same request signed over HTTP (llms.txt section 5). To add an MCP app, your human uses the /owner/add-app page of this site.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.
